_comment: Spine GOVERNED evidence (PR #89, DEC-062 extension). Every claim names a test file and the exact test title inside it; scripts/verify-governance-evidence.mjs fails when the file or the title is not there. GOVERNED means authorization, audit, write-guards and lifecycle are enforced — proven by RBAC tests, audit-chain verification, and period-close guards. Entity-scope authorization is explicitly BLOCKED-ON-OWNER O9 and must not be inferred from active entity. SOX authority O4, server authority Q6, and native durability O7 remain open and are stated as boundaries.

policy.route: A routed screen may be graded GOVERNED only when authorization (RBAC action), audit (hash-chained record), and write-guards (period-close) are each evidenced, and entity-scope is either evidenced or explicitly marked BLOCKED-ON-OWNER O9 with the owner question stated. A claim pointing at the page it grades proves nothing.
policy.capability: A capability may be graded GOVERNED when at least one test exercises its authorization guard, its audit record, and its lifecycle/write-guard enforcement. The test file must be a *.test.ts/*.test.tsx and the title must appear verbatim.
policy.entityScope: O9 is unanswered, so entity-scope authorization is BLOCKED-ON-OWNER. The authoritative entity set is undefined, switchEntity is policy-blocked, and activeEntityId must not be read as an authorization decision. This is the correct answer, not a defect.
policy.auditChain: auditTrailStore is the single canonical client-side authority (DEC-025). Every other chain-like module is classified in src/services/audit/auditChainCensus.test.ts with an explicit disposition, persistence flag, authority boundary and decision reference. Restart durability cannot be claimed without O7, SOX authority without O4, server authority without Q6.
policy.rbac: AST census pins 409 Zustand store actions = 302 guarded + 107 individually reasoned exceptions (N3). The census is enforced by src/store/rbacMatrixCompleteness.test.ts and pinned in docs/MASTER_CHECKLIST_COVERAGE.md row 26. Payload-source authentication for the GDPR bridge remains a bounded exception that disclaims general audit authority.
